message: ミロテア寮
Huh? There's a crowd gathered in front of the dorm.

name: Helena
message: 「Haaai, Shio-chan\s04 Next up are carrot rounds~」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Lady Helena, I did not come here to perform such acrobatics!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmph, I'm not listening! Toss~♪」
The ingredients Helena tosses trace a parabola through the air.

name: Shio
message: 「Guh... Raging Slash!」
Shio-chan's naginata roars fiercely, and the ingredients are prepped mid-air.

name: Sally
message: 「Coming through, coming through, excuse me!」
Sally-chan flies just above the ground holding a large platter, catching every single falling ingredient. It's a well-coordinated team effort.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, what are you even doing, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「Did you know? Back when I was a student here, Miroteia Dormitory had a small cafeteria exclusively for dorm residents.」

name: Shio
message: 「Pardon the interruption while you converse. I shall take my leave now--」

name: Helena
message: 「Daikon radish, julienned! Toss~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Thundering Strike!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyaaaah, keeping all this from falling is super tough!」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you a dorm resident, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「No, I wasn't. A friend of mine lived there, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「She always went on and on about how delicious the dorm meals were... but since I wasn't a resident, I wasn't allowed to eat there.」

name: Shio
message: 「Stealthily, stealthily...」

name: Helena
message: 「Cabbage, finely minced! Toss~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Quaking Cleave!」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawah! Isn't catching all this getting harder and harder?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did old dorm residents really get three square meals and afternoon naps?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Unfortunately, the year before I became chairwoman, demand dried up and the cafeteria was shut down.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, there's Prier too, and anyone who cooks for themselves probably just handles it on their own……」

name: Shio
message: 「Sneak, sneak……」

name: Helena
message: 「How naive, little one! Did you think you could escape my wicked eye!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah, Lady Helena! This humble one merely came from Asukai Shrine to donate ingredients to the student dorms!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Is prepping the food not the duty of the dorm residents!」

name: Helena
message: 「On the day of the actual event, yes, but today is just a test run」

name: Helena
message: 「Fohoho, and so…… potatoes, diced! Ups-a-daisy♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Aah, if they drop, the ingredients will bruise……! In that case, Gust!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa. Yay, that made things super easy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, do you know what kind of attraction the dorm is putting on for KiraFes?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm. A cafe, I think……」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, could it be!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Just for KiraFes, they decided to recreate the dorm's old meals」

name: Helena
message: 「Today is an early taste-testing session. I'll finally get to savor that long-awaited menu」

name: Helena
message: 「On the 27th, former dorm residents who catch wind of the rumor might even drop by to visit. I'm truly looking forward to it」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Helena! While elders ought to be respected, please spare a thought for current students like this humble one as well!」

name: Shio
message: 「Allow me to say one word on the matter! A demon-slaying blade is not meant for chopping vegetables!!」

name: Helena
message: 「A first-year who speaks her mind right to the chairwoman's face without flinching, huh. I look forward to seeing how you grow」

name: Helena
message: 「And with that said, one more round\s04 Turnips, rotary-peeled! Ups-a-daisy♪」

name: Shio
message: 「With what said!? Flash!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nnn…… nnn? Awright\s07 Sally-chan nailed it!」

name: Sally
message: 「I love Shio-chii for having a 'waste-not heart' way bigger than her 'demon-slaying miko pride'♪」

name: Shio
message: 「That is hardly defending me……」

name: Synn
message: 「Were the dorm meals mostly vegetarian?」

name: Helena
message: 「No way. There are tons of growing kids with big appetites here, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, Shio-chan, I'll have you fillet the fish into three pieces」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I have always been taught to grill fish whole and eat it as is……」

name: Helena
message: 「Stop being so soft! Do you think you'll make it to Nationals with that attitude!? Don't you want the crimson championship banner you've dreamed of!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan is in the Naginata Club, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「One, two, toss~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Wha, wha-wha!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Butler!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave the rescue of my young lady's schoolmate to this butler, Riesling Toyama」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! The fish that got shot bang-bang came raining down as pretty sashimi. Catch, catch♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, no, no! Impossible, impossible, impossible!」

name: Shio
message: 「Pfft! That concludes the prep work. Now, I truly must take my leave!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, good work」

name: Helena
message: 「Next up is the cooking and tasting party. Since you're already here, Shio-chan, why don't you stay and eat?」

name: Shio
message: 「I decline!」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, Tamiko-chan, please」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Shio, replenishing nutrients after training is entirely logical」

name: Shio
message: 「If Sir Butler says so, then I shall gladly partake in the meal」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, you come along too」

name: Helena
message: 「As president, learning about how the dorm used to be will be a good study experience for you」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way…… ufufu, Shio-chan, you were pretty into it back there, weren't you?」

name: Shio
message: 「Gasp!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Me too, me too! I wanna eat something delicious♪」
Thanks to Helena's kindness, I enjoyed a meal at the restored dormitory.
It had a somehow nostalgic, warm, home-cooked flavor.
